GOVERNING LAW, JURISDICTION AND ARBITRATION
(i) All disputes shall be referred to arbitration as per the provisions of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
(ii) The Parties hereby agree that all disputes shall be referred to and adjudicated by the sole arbitrator to be mutually appointed by the Parties.
(iii) In the event the Lender intends to invoke arbitration, the Lender shall propose 3 (three) names from its panel of arbitrators, of which the Borrower shall have an option to select one as the sole arbitrator within 7 (seven) days. In case the Borrower fails to revert within 7 (seven) days, the Lender may choose any one from the list as sole arbitrator.
(iv) The arbitrator may conduct the proceedings electronically or physically. The venue of arbitration proceedings shall be at Chennai.
(v) The arbitration proceedings may also be conducted through an Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) Platform, and documents may be submitted through the online platform.
